scenes.hook: H T M L Meta Tags. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Document metadata describes a page to browsers and other services. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: The title element supplies the browser tab title.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: The viewport meta tag supports appropriate sizing on mobile screens. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Metadata belongs in the head; visible page content belongs in the body.

scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
